RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, December 18, 2017/Agrahayana 27, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Defence; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Earth Sciences;
Environment, Forest and Climate Change; Information and
Broadcasting; Mines; Panchayati Raj; Road Transport and
Highways; Rural Development; Science and Technology;
Shipping; Textiles; Water Resources, River
Development and Ganga Rejuvenation)
Total number of questions — 15
Fund sharing pattern for PMGSY
*16. SHRI DILIP KUMAR TIRKEY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Pradhan
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) was
a 100 per cent Central Government funded
scheme before the revision of fund sharing
pattern with 60 per cent share from the
Central Government and rest 40 per cent
as the State share;
(b) if so, whether the changed fund
sharing pattern has adversely affected the
implementation of the scheme in various
States; and
(c) if so, the corresponding figures of
the progress made under the scheme since
the change in fund sharing pattern?
Deaths due to pollution
*17. SHRIMATI JHARNA DAS
BAIDYA: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND
CLIMATE CHANGE be pleased to state:
6
(a) whether it is a fact that 30 per cent
of the premature deaths in the country have
occurred due to air pollution according to
the Report of the Centre for Science and
Environment (CSE);
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the preventive
measures Government has taken in this
regard?
Conservation of mangrove jungles in
Maharashtra
*18. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT,
FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that mangrove
jungles around Mumbai and other coastal
areas of Maharashtra are decreasing
rapidly;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government has taken
or proposes to take to substantially increase
mangrove jungles there?

7
Encroachment of forest land
*19. SHRI HARSHVARDHAN
SINGH DUNGARPUR: Will the Minister
of ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND
CLIMATE CHANGE be pleased to state:
(a) the actual forest land and that
encroached by people in the country during
the last three years and the current year,
State-wise;
(b) whether any complaint has been
received from Rajasthan regarding such
encroachment by a community;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken thereon and if not, the reasons
therefor;
(d) whether any special scheme is being
implemented for the States, having less
forest land, to bring them at par with
national average; and
(e) if so, the details and the outcome
thereof and the estimated amount likely to
be spent in this regard?
Procurement of single-engine fighters
for Air Force
*20. SHRIMATI SASIKALA
PUSHPA: Will the Minister of  DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has proposed
to procure single-engine fighters for its
Air Force from a private sector player  with
technology transfer by the foreign original
equipment manufacturer;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Enhancement of funds for Power Tex
India Scheme
*21. SHRI R. V AITHILINGAM: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that funds are
required to meet the requirement of Power
Tex India Scheme;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government is considering to enhance the
capital subsidy for powerloom from 10 per
cent to 30 per cent;
(c) whether it is also a fact that about
ten proposals were sanctioned under the
yarn bank and group workshed scheme and
another seventy applications are pending;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Dynamic and transparent defence
procurement policy
†*22. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several policy
measures have been taken by Government
with an objective to make defence
procurement policy dynamic and
transparent during the last three years and
as a result of which the system has become
corruption free completely;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a decision has been taken
to contact directly the concerned foreign
Government instead of concerned company
for defence procurement; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

8
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Banning of films by State Governments
*23. SHRI VIVEK K. TANKHA: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Governments have
the power to ban exhibition of a film before
it is censored and certified by Central Board
of Film Certification (CBFC);
(b) if so, whether it violates the
principles of rule of  law and prejudices
the decision of CBFC and whether it would
injunct a statutory body from doing its duty;
and
(c) what are the Ministry’s comments
on the same?
Environmental damage due to illegal
mining
†*24. CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
YAD

Procurement of fighter planes
†161. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the process of procuring
fighter planes was going on for a long time
to enhance the capacity of Indian Air Force
and the process of procurement of fighter
planes (Rafale) could not be completed
earlier;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the process was completed
promptly and transparently by the present
Government; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Shortage of ammunition in WWR
162. PROF. M.V. RAJEEV
GOWDA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a shortage of
ammunition held in War Wastage Reserve
(WWR) as on November, 2017;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the details of procurement orders for
ammunition which are pending;
(d) whether the Ministry is taking steps
to reduce the shortage of ammunition in
WWR; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Agreement with France for supply of
Rafale fighter jets
163. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has made an agreement with France for
supply of Rafale fighter jets;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the difference between
original request for proposal issued in 2007
and present agreement; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
(d) what is the amount Government is
spending for this deal?
Recruitment of female cadets in the
Army, Navy and Air Force
164. SHRI TIRUCHI SIVA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of female cadets who
have been recruited in the Army, Air Force
and Navy during the last three years; and
(b) whether Government is taking any
initiative to increase the participation of
women in the defence services of the
country and if so, the details thereof?
Private partner in joint venture of
Rafale aircraft
165. SHRI K.T.S. TULSI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the basis for making Reliance
Defence Limited, a private company as a
joint venture partner in the purchase of 36
Rafale aircrafts from France, excluding
Government     controlled     Hindustan
Aeronautics Limited; and
(b) the details thereof'?
Consultation of CCS on Rafale aircraft
166. SHRI K.T.S. TULSI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Cabinet Committee on
Security (CCS) was consulted before or
after the announcement of purchase of 36
Rafale aircrafts by the Hon’ble Prime
Minister in France in 2015; and
(b) the details thereof?
Defence lands and buildings used for
commercial purposes
167. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV
GOWDA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the total area (in sq. km) of defence
lands and the number of defence buildings
that are being used for commercial
purposes;
(b) the amount of revenue received from
the above commercial use, every year
during the last three years; and
(c) the details of utilization of revenue
collected from this use?
Shortage of ammunition in Army's
stock
168. SHRI RANJIB BISWAL: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that, despite
concerns, there is no significant
improvement in army's stocks of
ammunition;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for not making adequate
procurement when the C&AG in its 2015
Report pointed out that there is a massive
ammunition shortage with reserves that
would barely last 20 days of intense
fighting;
(d) what per cent of Army's ammunition
is being procured domestically and from
international market; and
(e) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to augment defence procurement?

40
Status of report on litigation and allied
issues
169. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the status of the Report of
Expert Committee constituted by the
Minister to suggest measures for reducing
on litigation and allied issues submitted on
24 November, 2015;
(b) whether the process of
implementation of the report has started,
as per the announcement made by
Government on 21 August, 2016;
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps Government has taken to
reduce litigation against soldiers?
Holding of defence funds by UN

CHOWDHURY: W ill the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the United Nations has held
